name: Magicians Unite
extDescription: Activate only if you control 2 or more face-up Attack Position Spellcaster-Type monsters, select 1 of them. The ATK of the selected monster becomes 3000 until the end of this turn. Spellcaster-Type monster(s) you control cannot attack this turn, except the selected monster.

name: Spirit Reaper
extDescription: This card cannot be destroyed by battle. Destroy this card when it is targeted by the effect of a Spell, Trap, or Effect Monster. If this card successfully attacks directly, your opponent randomly discards 1 card.

name: Gravekeeper's Spy
extDescription: FLIP: Special Summon 1 "Gravekeeper's" monster with 1500 or less ATK from you Deck.

name: Snipe Hunter
extDescription: Discard 1 card from your hand.  Select 1 card on the field and roll a six-sided die.  If the result is not 1 or 6, destroy the selected card.

name: Dark World Lightning
extDescription: Select 1 face-down card on the field and destroy it, and after that, select 1 card from your hand and discard it.

name: D.D. Assailant
extDescription: When this card is destroyed as a result of battle with your opponent's monster, remove from play both this card and the opponent's monster that destroyed this card.

name: Goldd, Wu-Lord of Dark World
cleanName: Goldd Wu Lord of Dark World
extDescription: If this card is discarded from your hand to the Graveyard by a card effect, Special Summon it. When this card is discarded from the hand to the Graveyard by your opponent's card effect, choose 2 cards on your opponent's field and destroy them.

name: Manticore of Darkness
extDescription: During the End Phase of the turn this card is sent to the Graveyard, you can send 1 Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast-Type Monster Card from your hand or your side of the field to the Graveyard to Special Summon this card from the Graveyard.

name: The Agent of Judgment - Saturn
extDescription: While your Life Points are higher than your opponent's, you can Tribute this card to inflict damage to your opponent equal to the difference. If you do not control "The Sanctuary in the Sky", this effect is not applied. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect.

name: Pikeru's Circle of Enchantment
extDescription: Damage to you from card effects becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

name: Widespread Ruin
extDescription: Activate only when your opponent's monster declare an attack. Destroy 1 Attack Position monster you opponent controls with the highest ATK. (If it's a tie, you get to choose.)

name: Fairy Dragon
extDescription: This beautiful Dragon spirit harbors hidden strength.

name: Chiron the Mage
extDescription: Once per turn, you can discard 1 Spell Card from your hand to destroy 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls.

name: Kaibaman
extDescription: You can Tribute this card to Special Summon 1 "Blue-Eyes White Dragon" from your hand.

name: B.E.S. Crystal Core
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned, put 3 counters on it. This card cannot be destroyed by battle. If this card battles a monster, remove 1 counter from this card at the end of the Damage Step. If you cannot, destroy it. Once per turn, during your Main Phase, you can change 1 face-up Attack Position monster your opponent controls to face-up Defense Position.

name: Gravekeeper's Chief
extDescription: You can have only control 1 "Gravekeeper's Chief" at a time. Your Graveyard is not affected by "Necrovalley". When you Tribute Summon, you can Special Summon 1 monster that includes "Gravekeeper's" monster from your Graveyard.

name: Wild Nature's Release
extDescription: Select 1 Beast-Type or Beast-Warrior-Type monster; it gains ATK equal to its DEF until the end of this turn. Destroy the monster during the End Phase.

name: A Feather of the Phoenix
extDescription: Discard 1 card from your hand. Select 1 card from your Graveyard and return it to the top of your Deck.

name: Contract with the Abyss
extDescription: This card is used to Ritual Summon any DARK Ritual Monster. You must also Tribute monsters from the field or your hand whose total Levels equal the Level of the Ritual Monster you are Ritual Summoning.

name: Necrovalley
extDescription:
New Font Errata: All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF. Cards in either player's Graveyard cannot be banished. Negate any card effect that would move a card in the Graveyard, other than itself, to a different place.

Negate the effects of Spell, Trap, and Monster Cards that affect a card(s) in the Graveyard. Neither player can remove from play cards in the Graveyard. All "Gravekeeper's" monsters gain 500 ATK and DEF.
